decision.text: Write cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_mail_that_stands_600s_raises.py on the 7cb1989e7825 rig (BusDevice.scratch('bus_b300'), BusProcess(bus), bus.set_diagnostic_receiver(_Inbox) where _Inbox.raised() keeps records whose gate is raise_trouble). Stuck mail is a reply to a shimless asker (bus.post(sender='testing-b300-answerer', to='testing-b300-asker', channel='personal', why=..., reply_to='testing-b300-request-id')), aged by setting the returned envelope's 'date' to (now - 700s).isoformat(timespec='seconds'). PROVES = {'b30069239480': {'all': 'mail_that_stands_600s_raises_at_the_flush', ...}}. Four teeth driven by proc.answer({'op':'flush'}, in_process=True): one trouble whose pointer is mail-testing-b300-asker-stood-600s naming the envelope id; two flushes still one; a 5s-old envelope never named; op_flush json keeps flushed/receipts and the stood envelope stays in bus.undelivered(). Red against today's server.py (3 of 4 teeth red, measured 2026-10-18). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.

decision.step: unlisted: report standing mail past 600s at op_flush, once per envelope
decision.text: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py: module constant STOOD_S = 600 citing Akien 2026-10-18; BusProcess.__init__ adds self._stood_reported: set[str]; op_flush becomes flushed = self.bus.flush(); flushed['stood'] = self.report_stood(); return {'ok': True, 'json': flushed}. New method report_stood(now=None) walks self.bus.undelivered(limit=1_000_000), skips ids in _stood_reported, computes age via a module helper _age_s(date, now) (fromisoformat of the str, or a datetime as-is, tz-aware converted to naive local, None if unreadable), skips age < STOOD_S, and for the rest calls self.bus.raise_trouble(f'mail-{to}-stood-{STOOD_S}s', why=<to, sender, age, why, and whether a shim for to is held via self.roster.held>, detail={envelope, sender, addressee, why, verb, reply_to, date, age_s, held}), adds the id to _stood_reported, and returns the count raised. An unreadable date is raised with age unknown, never skipped (Law 7). No wake or delivery is retried (bus clause 5). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'.
